SelectorQuery NodesRef.scrollOffset(function callback)

Query request for the scrolling position of an added node. The unit is pixel. The node must be scroll-view or viewport, and the return value is SelectorQuery corresponding to NodesRef.

Parameter

function callback

Callback function. Executing the SelectorQuery.exec method returns the node information in callback.

Parameter

Object res
Attribute Type Description
id String Node ID.
dataset Object Node dataset.
scrollLeft Number Horizontal scrolling position of the node.
scrollTop Number Vertical scrolling position of the node.

Return Value

SelectorQuery

Sample Code

Page({
  getScrollOffset () {
    ma.createSelectorQuery().selectViewport().scrollOffset(function(res){
     res.id      // Node ID.
      res.dataset    // Node dataset. 
      res.scrollLeft // Horizontal scrolling position of the node. 
      res.scrollTop  // Vertical scrolling position of the node. 
    }).exec()
  }
})
